title: Ads
content_data:
An ad is the smallest advertising unit and is the content presented to the target audience.

This group consists of the following endpoints:
* [Get Upgraded Smart+ Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843317378982914)
* [Create an Upgraded Smart+ Ad](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843317390059522)
* [Update an Upgraded Smart+ Ad](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843317411665921)
* [Update the operation statuses of Upgraded Smart+ Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843317423164482)
* [Disable or enable creatives in an Upgraded Smart+ Ad](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843317433577601)
* [Preview Upgraded Smart+ Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843317445798914)
